title: Tubeworld?
content: I took an afternoon nap earlier today and briefly saw essentially this exact image but with several rows of probably hundreds of people waiting in line to get into these pods and be transported somewhere unknown. The pods had little window-like compartments that opened up and closed once somebody got in and then they’d zoom up those tubes at ludicrous speeds. This was one of the most oddly vivid dreams I’ve ever had. Anyone seen this or have any clues as to where the pods are going? Anything?
